status: VISUALIZATION DIRECTOR PASS - design spec only, not implemented
purpose: Standardized scientific CAMERA LANGUAGE for scale transitions. Every transition specifies movement, zoom, FOV, clipping/cross-section, focus/DoF, label behavior, speed, narrative purpose, and a final decision. Scale is always labelled; B1 has NO body->organ->bloodstream systemic descent (topical).
principles: consistent complexity (one abstraction level per scale)
a persistent scale bar + scale-name badge on every transition
cross-section reveal rather than flythrough for the skin dive
DoF used to isolate the load-bearing element, not for spectacle
